content.user_title: Resolve ERC-8004 Agents and Build AgentCards
content.value_statement: On-chain agent identities and registry metadata are difficult to inspect consistently. This skill resolves ERC-8004 identities and scaffolds registration-v1 AgentCards.
actual_capabilities: Resolve an ERC-8004 agent ID to its owner and decoded AgentCard.
Handle AgentCards referenced through data, HTTPS, and IPFS token URIs.
List canonical Identity and Reputation Registry addresses with supported chains.
Generate registration-v1 AgentCards with services, trust models, and x402 support.
Produce an optional data URI representation for generated AgentCards.
Explain the current read-only scope and deferred write operations.
limitations: It does not register agents or submit feedback and validation transactions.
ERC-8004 is a draft, so write interfaces and registry details may change.
Reliable reads may require a configured BASE_RPC_URL endpoint.
Generated AgentCards are not hosted or registered automatically.

best_practices: Verify the target chain and agent ID before resolving identity metadata.
Review remote AgentCard contents before trusting endpoints or capability claims.
Host generated metadata reliably before completing registration through verified reference contracts.
anti_patterns: Do not treat published AgentCard claims as independently verified reputation.
Do not submit write transactions using draft or unverified contract interfaces.
Do not depend on public RPC endpoints for production reliability.

faq.question: What is ERC-8004?
faq.answer: ERC-8004 is a draft standard for portable on-chain agent identity and reputation.

faq.question: Can this skill register an agent?
faq.answer: No. It supports reads and AgentCard scaffolding, while registration and other writes remain deferred.

faq.question: Which AgentCard locations can it resolve?
faq.answer: It handles data, HTTPS, and IPFS token URI references described by the skill.

faq.question: Does it support x402 metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. Generated registration-v1 AgentCards can declare x402 support.

faq.question: Why configure BASE_RPC_URL?
faq.answer: A dedicated Base RPC endpoint can improve reliability when public fallback endpoints are limited.

faq.question: Does resolution prove an agent is trustworthy?
faq.answer: No. Resolution shows registered ownership and published metadata, but users must assess reputation and service claims separately.
